roadmap.out_of_scope: No change to REQUEST_TIMEOUT (5 s), the 503 index_busy response, the 1001-row cap, or any response shape. No push until the user says so.

phases.name: Search reads references in one batched query

steps.name: One batched references read per search
steps.description: crates/adapter-index-store/src/lib.rs: select_rows stops calling references_for once per row. Under the same lock it runs one query: the references JOINed to the same WHERE/ORDER BY cid/LIMIT row set (the same predicate and cap as the row query; build it from one source so they cannot drift). A pure function then attaches the references to each claim, ordered by referenced_cid, ref_type within each claim; a claim with no references gets an empty Vec. Remove references_for if nothing else uses it, or keep it for get_by_cid only if that is simpler. Also crates/openlore-indexer/src/search_handler.rs flat_attributed_rows (about :182-200): replace the per-row linear search with a map lookup. Behaviour is unchanged.
criteria: New store test: upsert claims on one object, some with 2+ references in mixed order. query_by_object returns, for each claim, exactly the references (and order) the per-row path returned, and empty for claims without references. The pure attach function gets a proptest.
New store test: the time for query_by_object over 1001 matching claims divided by the time over 101 is < 3 (best of 3 runs each, to cut noise). Fails today (about 10x). Record the RED.
AS-53 and all indexer_deployment_* acceptance tests pass; counter-annotation tests (AVC-6, OD-AV-7 and any test in the workspace touching references) pass
